summary.result: Analysis of upper‐air sounding data showed that the more snowfall occurs, the higher the altitude of northwesterly wind.
summary.background: In this study, based on 10 cases of heavy snowfall observed in the Youngdong area during the past five years (2014‐2018), the characteristics of surface and upper‐air meteorological element change were examined.
